1: /* level.js — constrói a geometria do nível a partir do grid puro (map.js).
2:  * 🎨 Render: usa Three.js (CanvasTexture, BufferGeometry, PointLight).
3:  * Exporta buildLevel(map, THREE) → { group, update, doorMeshes, exitPos, torchLights }.
4:  */
5: import { C } from './constants.js';
6: import * as THREE from 'three';
7: 
8: /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
9:  * Texturas procedurais (canvas 128×128) — padrão DOOM retrô.
10:  * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
11: const TEX = {
12:   startan: { base: '#7a2b20', dark: '#4a1510', rivet: '#c96f4a' },
13:   tech:    { base: '#4a5058', dark: '#2b2f36', rivet: '#8a93a0' },
14:   brick:   { base: '#5a2a1e', dark: '#3a1a12', rivet: '#7a4a3a' },
15:   emblem:  { base: '#2e3a2e', dark: '#1c241c', rivet: '#7a9a6a' },
16:   metal:   { base: '#6a7078', dark: '#3a3e44', rivet: '#a0a8b4' },
17: };
18: 
19: function makeCanvasTexture(name, w = 128, h = 128) {
20:   const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
21:   canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h;
22:   const g = canvas.getContext('2d');
23:   const t = TEX[name] || TEX.tech;
24:   g.fillStyle = t.base;
25:   g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
26: 
27:   if (name === 'startan') {
28:     // painéis verticais com rebites nas bordas
29:     for (let x = 0; x < w; x += 16) {
30:       g.fillStyle = t.dark;
31:       g.fillRect(x, 0, 3, h);
32:       g.fillStyle = t.rivet;
33:       for (let y = 8; y < h; y += 16) {
34:         g.beginPath(); g.arc(x + 1.5, y, 1.6, 0, 7); g.fill();
35:         g.beginPath(); g.arc(x + 14.5, y, 1.6, 0, 7); g.fill();
36:       }
37:     }
38:     g.fillStyle = t.rivet;
39:     g.fillRect(0, 0, w, 4);
40:     g.fillRect(0, h - 4, w, 4);
41:   } else if (name === 'tech') {
42:     // placas metálicas + linhas de junção + parafusos
43:     for (let x = 0; x < w; x += 32) {
44:       g.fillStyle = t.dark;
45:       g.fillRect(x, 0, 2, h);
46:       for (let y = 8; y < h; y += 24) {
47:         g.fillStyle = t.rivet;
48:         g.beginPath(); g.arc(x + 1, y, 1.8, 0, 7); g.fill();
49:         g.beginPath(); g.arc(x + 31, y, 1.8, 0, 7); g.fill();
50:       }
51:     }
52:   } else if (name === 'brick') {
53:     // tijolos 16×8 com argamassa escura
54:     for (let y = 0; y < h; y += 8) {
55:       const off = (y / 8) % 2 === 0 ? 0 : 8;
56:       for (let x = -8; x < w; x += 16) {
57:         const bx = x + off;
58:         g.fillStyle = t.rivet; // argamassa
59:         g.fillRect(bx, y, 16, 1);
60:         g.fillRect(bx, y, 1, 8);
61:       }
62:     }
63:   } else if (name === 'emblem') {
64:     // painel escuro + emblema central (losango + círculo)
65:     g.fillStyle = t.dark;
66:     g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
67:     g.fillStyle = t.rivet;
68:     g.strokeStyle = t.rivet;
69:     g.lineWidth = 3;
70:     g.strokeRect(4, 4, w - 8, h - 8);
71:     g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(w / 2, 24); g.lineTo(w - 30, h / 2); g.lineTo(w / 2, h - 24); g.lineTo(30, h / 2); g.closePath(); g.fill();
72:     g.beginPath(); g.arc(w / 2, h / 2, 18, 0, 7); g.fill();
73:   } else {
74:     // metal liso com rebites de canto
75:     g.fillStyle = t.dark;
76:     g.fillRect(0, 0, w, 4); g.fillRect(0, h - 4, w, 4);
77:     g.fillRect(0, 0, 4, h); g.fillRect(w - 4, 0, 4, h);
78:     g.fillStyle = t.rivet;
79:     [[6, 6], [w - 6, 6], [6, h - 6], [w - 6, h - 6]].forEach(([x, y]) => {
80:       g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, 2, 0, 7); g.fill();
81:     });
82:   }
83: 
84:   const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
85:   tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
86:   tex.wrapS = tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
87:   tex.magFilter = THREE.NearestFilter; // retrô: pixelado
88:   return tex;
89: }
90: 
91: /* Cache de texturas (uma por tipo). */
92: const texCache = new Map();
93: function getTexture(name) {
94:   if (!texCache.has(name)) texCache.set(name, makeCanvasTexture(name));
95:   return texCache.get(name);
96: }
97: 
98: /* Material MeshBasicMaterial — iluminação "falsa" embutida na textura (perf). */
99: function wallMaterial(name) {
100:   return new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: getTexture(name) });
101: }
102: 
103: /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
104:  * Acumulador de quads → BufferGeometry indexada (faces com normais + UV).
105:  * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
106: class QuadBuilder {
107:   constructor() {
108:     this.pos = [];
109:     this.nrm = [];
110:     this.uv = [];
111:     this.idx = [];
112:   }
113:   /* Adiciona um quad vertical (parede): centro (cx,cz), largura dw, altura dh,
114:    * y-base by, normal (nx,nz) e uv-variante face (0..1). */
115:   quad(cx, cz, dw, dh, by, nx, nz, v) {
116:     const i = this.pos.length / 3;
117:     const hw = dw / 2;
118:     // face frontal orientada pela normal
119:     const tx = -nz, tz = nx; // tangente
120:     const p = [
121:       cx - tx * hw, by,     cz - tz * hw,
122:       cx + tx * hw, by,     cz + tz * hw,
123:       cx + tx * hw, by + dh, cz + tz * hw,
124:       cx - tx * hw, by + dh, cz - tz * hw,
125:     ];
126:     this.pos.push(...p);
127:     for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) this.nrm.push(nx, 0, nz);
128:     // UVs: face vertical divide a textura em 4 faixas (v) — melhor variedade
129:     const u0 = 0, u1 = dw, v0 = v * 0.25, v1 = v0 + 0.25;
130:     this.uv.push(u0, v0, u1, v0, u1, v1, u0, v1);
131:     this.idx.push(i, i + 1, i + 2, i, i + 2, i + 3);
132:   }
133:   /* Adiciona um quad horizontal (chão/teto): centro (cx,cz), tamanho (w,h),
134:    * y fixo, normal (0,±1,0), v-face. */
135:   hquad(cx, cz, w, h, y, ny, v) {
136:     const i = this.pos.length / 3;
137:     const hw = w / 2, hh = h / 2;
138:     this.pos.push(
139:       cx - hw, y, cz - hh,
140:       cx + hw, y, cz - hh,
141:       cx + hw, y, cz + hh,
142:       cx - hw, y, cz + hh,
143:     );
144:     for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) this.nrm.push(0, ny, 0);
145:     this.uv.push(0, 0, w, 0, w, h, 0, h);
146:     this.idx.push(i, i + 1, i + 2, i, i + 2, i + 3);
147:   }
148:   build() {
149:     const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
150:     g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(this.pos, 3));
151:     g.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(this.nrm, 3));
152:     g.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(this.uv, 2));
153:     g.setIndex(this.idx);
154:     return g;
155:   }
156: }
157: 
158: /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
159:  * Construtor do nível
160:  * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
161: export function buildLevel(map, THREE) {
162:   const L = C.LEVEL;
163:   const group = new THREE.Group();
164:   const wallH = L.wallHeight;
165:   const ceilY = L.ceilingY;
166: 
167:   // builders por textura de parede
168:   const wallBuilders = new Map(); // nome → QuadBuilder
169:   function wallB(name) {
170:     if (!wallBuilders.has(name)) wallBuilders.set(name, new QuadBuilder());
171:     return wallBuilders.get(name);
172:   }
173:   const floorB = new QuadBuilder();
174:   const ceilB = new QuadBuilder();
175: 
176:   const h = map.H, w = map.W;
177:   for (let r = 0; r < h; r++) {
178:     for (let c = 0; c < w; c++) {
179:       const ch = map.grid[r][c];
180:       const isWall = ch === '#';
181:       const cx = c + 0.5, cz = r + 0.5;
182:       const zname = map.zone(r, c);
183: 
184:       // chão e teto (todos os tipos)
185:       const ftex = zname === 'arena' ? 'emblem' : zname === 'entrada' ? 'startan' : zname === 'catacumbas' || zname === 'armadilha' ? 'brick' : 'tech';
186:       const ctex = ftex === 'emblem' ? 'metal' : ftex;
187:       floorB.hquad(cx, cz, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0);
188:       ceilB.hquad(cx, cz, 1, 1, ceilY, -1, 0);
189: 
190:       if (isWall) {
191:         const b = wallB(ftex === 'emblem' ? 'emblem' : ftex);
192:         const v = (r + c) % 4;
193:         if (c > 0 && !map.isSolid(r, c - 1)) b.quad(cx - 0.5, cz, 1, wallH, 0, -1, 0, v);          // oeste
194:         if (c < w - 1 && !map.isSolid(r, c + 1)) b.quad(cx + 0.5, cz, 1, wallH, 0, 1, 0, v);        // leste
195:         if (r > 0 && !map.isSolid(r - 1, c)) b.quad(cx, cz - 0.5, 1, wallH, 0, 0, -1, v);          // norte
196:         if (r < h - 1 && !map.isSolid(r + 1, c)) b.quad(cx, cz + 0.5, 1, wallH, 0, 0, 1, v);        // sul
197:       }
198:     }
199:   }
200: 
201:   // monta meshes das paredes (um por textura)
202:   for (const [name, b] of wallBuilders) {
203:     const m = new THREE.Mesh(b.build(), wallMaterial(name));
204:     m.matrixAutoUpdate = false;
205:     group.add(m);
206:   }
207: 
208:   // chão + teto
209:   group.add(new THREE.Mesh(floorB.build(), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: getTexture('metal'), color: 0x8a8a94 })));
210:   const ceilMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: getTexture('metal'), color: 0x55555c });
211:   group.add(new THREE.Mesh(ceilB.build(), ceilMat));
212: 
213:   // ---- portas ---------------------------------------------------------------
214:   const doorMeshes = [];
215:   for (const d of map.doors) {
216:     const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, L.doorHeight, 0.18);
217:     const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: getTexture('metal') });
218:     const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
219:     m.position.set(d.c + 0.5, L.doorHeight / 2 - 0.02, d.r + 0.5);
220:     group.add(m);
221:     doorMeshes.push({ d, mesh: m });
222:   }
223:   // segredos = portas que sobem quando abertas
224:   for (const s of map.secrets) {
225:     const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, L.doorHeight, 0.18);
226:     const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: getTexture('brick') });
227:     const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
228:     m.position.set(s.c + 0.5, L.doorHeight / 2 - 0.02, s.r + 0.5);
229:     group.add(m);
230:     doorMeshes.push({ d: s, mesh: m, isSecret: true });
231:   }
232: 
233:   // ---- saída ----------------------------------------------------------------
234:   let exitPos = null;
235:   for (const e of map.exits) {
236:     const px = e.c + 0.5, pz = e.r + 0.5;
237:     exitPos = { x: px, z: pz };
238:     // pilar emissivo + plano brilhante virado para o centro da arena
239:     const pillar = new THREE.Mesh(
240:       new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.22, 0.34, 2.6, 10),
241:       new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x88ff88 }),
242:     );
243:     pillar.position.set(px, 1.3, pz);
244:     group.add(pillar);
245:     const glow = new THREE.Mesh(
246:       new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.9, 2.6),
247:       new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x66ff66, transparent: true, opacity: 0.85 }),
248:     );
249:     glow.position.set(px, 1.3, pz + 0.5);
250:     group.add(glow);
251:   }
252: 
253:   // ---- lava ----------------------------------------------------------------
254:   const lavaMats = [];
255:   for (let r = 0; r < h; r++) {
256:     for (let c = 0; c < w; c++) {
257:       if (map.grid[r][c] !== '~') continue;
258:       const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
259:         color: 0xff5a00, transparent: true, opacity: 0.9,
260:       });
261:       const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.96, 0.96), mat);
262:       m.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
263:       m.position.set(c + 0.5, 0.02, r + 0.5);
264:       group.add(m);
265:       lavaMats.push(mat);
266:     }
267:   }
268: 
269:   // ---- tochas (luz pontual + chama) ------------------------------------------
270:   const torchLights = [];
271:   for (const t of map.torches) {
272:     const x = t.x, z = t.z;
273:     const flame = new THREE.Mesh(
274:       new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.07, 0.35, 6),
275:       new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffaa33 }),
276:     );
277:     flame.position.set(x, 1.75, z);
278:     group.add(flame);
279:     // agrupa luzes: compartilha uma única PointLight a cada par (draw calls)
280:     if (torchLights.length < 6) {
281:       const light = new THREE.PointLight(0xff8844, 0.9, 9, 1.6);
282:       light.position.set(x, 1.9, z);
283:       group.add(light);
284:       torchLights.push({ light, base: 0.9, phase: Math.random() * 10 });
285:     }
286:   }
287: 
288:   // ---- update por frame ------------------------------------------------------
289:   let elapsed = 0;
290:   function update(dt) {
291:     elapsed += dt;
292:     // portas: sobem quando abertas; segredos descem (t: 0 fechada → 1 aberta)
293:     for (const { d, mesh, isSecret } of doorMeshes) {
294:       const target = d.open ? 1 : 0;
295:       d.t += (target - d.t) * Math.min(1, dt * C.LEVEL.doorSpeed);
296:       const yOpen = L.doorHeight / 2 - 0.02;
297:       const yClosed = isSecret ? L.doorHeight + 0.5 : yOpen; // segredo fica acima, porta no lugar
298:       const y = yClosed + (yOpen - yClosed) * d.t;
299:       mesh.position.y = y;
300:       mesh.visible = d.t > 0.05;
301:     }
302:     // lava pulsa
303:     for (const m of lavaMats) m.color.setHSL(0.03 + 0.02 * Math.sin(elapsed * 2.2), 1, 0.55 + 0.08 * Math.sin(elapsed * 3.1));
304:     // tochas tremeluzem
305:     for (const tl of torchLights) {
306:       const n = Math.sin(elapsed * 11 + tl.phase) * 0.5 + Math.sin(elapsed * 23 + tl.phase * 2) * 0.5;
307:       tl.light.intensity = tl.base * (0.55 + 0.45 * n);
308:     }
309:   }
310: 
311:   return { group, update, doorMeshes, exitPos, torchLights };
312: }
313: 
314: export default { buildLevel, getTexture };

1: /* engine.js — núcleo Three.js: renderer, cena, câmera, luzes globais, input, loop, FPS. */
2: import * as THREE from 'three';
3: import C from './constants.js';
4: 
5: export function createEngine(canvas) {
6:   const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: true, powerPreference: 'high-performance' });
7:   renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, C.RENDER.pixelRatioCap));
8:   renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
9: 
10:   const scene = new THREE.Scene();
11:   scene.background = new THREE.Color(C.RENDER.background);
12:   scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(C.RENDER.background, C.RENDER.fogNear, C.RENDER.fogFar);
13: 
14:   const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(C.RENDER.fov, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, C.RENDER.near, C.RENDER.far);
15:   camera.rotation.order = 'YXZ';
16:   scene.add(camera);
17: 
18:   const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0x8899bb, 0x445566, 0.9);
19:   scene.add(hemi);
20:   const ambient = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404050, 0.45);
21:   scene.add(ambient);
22: 
23:   const input = {
24:     keys: new Set(),
25:     pressed: new Set(),
26:     mx: 0, my: 0, scroll: 0,
27:     locked: false,
28:     sens: C.INPUT.mouseSens,
29:   };
30: 
31:   const onKeyDown = (e) => {
32:     if (!input.keys.has(e.code)) input.pressed.add(e.code);
33:     input.keys.add(e.code);
34:   };
35:   const onKeyUp = (e) => input.keys.delete(e.code);
36:   let lastClientX = null, lastClientY = null;
37:   const onMouseMove = (e) => {
38:     if (document.pointerLockElement === canvas) {
39:       input.mx += e.movementX; input.my += e.movementY;
40:       lastClientX = e.clientX; lastClientY = e.clientY;
41:       return;
42:     }
43:     if (lastClientX !== null && lastClientY !== null) {
44:       input.mx += e.clientX - lastClientX;
45:       input.my += e.clientY - lastClientY;
46:     }
47:     lastClientX = e.clientX; lastClientY = e.clientY;
48:   };
49:   const onWheel = (e) => { input.scroll += Math.sign(e.deltaY); };
50:   const requestLock = () => {
51:     if (document.pointerLockElement === canvas) return;
52:     try { canvas.requestPointerLock(); } catch { /* fora de user gesture — Q/E cobrem */ }
53:   };
54:   const onMouseDown = (e) => {
55:     if (e.button !== 0) return;
56:     if (!input.keys.has('Mouse0')) input.pressed.add('Mouse0');
57:     input.keys.add('Mouse0');
58:     requestLock();
59:   };
60:   const onMouseUp = (e) => { if (e.button === 0) input.keys.delete('Mouse0'); };
61:   const onLockChange = () => { input.locked = document.pointerLockElement === canvas; };
62:   const onResize = () => {
63:     camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
64:     camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
65:     renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
66:   };
67:   window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
68:   window.addEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
69:   document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
70:   window.addEventListener('mousedown', onMouseDown);
71:   window.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
72:   canvas.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: true });
73:   document.addEventListener('pointerlockchange', onLockChange);
74:   window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);
75: 
76:   function update(dt) {
77:     const d = dt > 0 ? dt : 0.016;
78:     const turn = (input.keys.has('KeyQ') || input.keys.has('ArrowLeft') ? 1 : 0) -
79:                  (input.keys.has('KeyE') || input.keys.has('ArrowRight') ? 1 : 0);
80:     if (turn !== 0) camera.rotation.y += turn * C.INPUT.turnSpeed * d;
81:     camera.rotation.y -= input.mx * input.sens;
82:     camera.rotation.x -= input.my * input.sens;
83:     const lim = Math.PI / 2 - 0.05;
84:     camera.rotation.x = Math.max(-lim, Math.min(lim, camera.rotation.x));
85:     input.mx = 0; input.my = 0; input.scroll = 0;
86:   }
87: 
88:   let onFrame = null;
89:   let last = performance.now();
90:   let fpsAcc = 0, fpsFrames = 0;
91:   const fps = { value: 0 };
92: 
93:   function frame() {
94:     requestAnimationFrame(frame);
95:     const now = performance.now();
96:     const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 0.05);
97:     last = now;
98:     fpsAcc += dt; fpsFrames++;
99:     if (fpsAcc >= 1) { fps.value = Math.round(fpsFrames / fpsAcc); fpsAcc = 0; fpsFrames = 0; }
100:     update(dt);
101:     onFrame?.(dt);
102:     renderer.render(scene, camera);
103:   }
104: 
105:   return {
106:     renderer, scene, camera, input, fps,
107:     wasPressed(code) {
108:       if (input.pressed.has(code)) { input.pressed.delete(code); return true; }
109:       return false;
110:     },
111:     requestLock() { try { canvas.requestPointerLock(); } catch { /* fora de user gesture — Q/E cobrem */ } },
112:     exitLock() { if (document.pointerLockElement) document.exitPointerLock(); },
113:     start(fn) { onFrame = fn; frame(); },
114:   };
115: }

1: /* main.js — bootstrap: monta todos os módulos, FSM (menu/playing/gameover/win),
2:  * eventos (dano, kill, pickup, porta, lava, saída) e API de debug (QA).
3:  * window.__registerMod é definido no index.html (antes deste módulo rodar).
4:  */
5: import * as THREE from 'three';
6: import C from './constants.js';
7: import { makeMap, dist2D } from './map.js';
8: import { createEngine } from './engine.js';
9: import { buildLevel } from './level.js';
10: import { createPlayer } from './player.js';
11: import { createWeapons } from './weapons.js';
12: import { createProjectiles } from './projectiles.js';
13: import { createEnemies } from './enemies.js';
14: import { createParticles } from './particles.js';
15: import { createMinimap } from './minimap.js';
16: import { createHUD } from './hud.js';
17: import './audio.js';
18: 
19: const canvas = document.getElementById('game-canvas');
20: const engine = createEngine(canvas);
21: const map = makeMap();
22: const level = buildLevel(map, THREE);
23: engine.scene.add(level.group);
24: 
25: const player = createPlayer(engine, map);
26: const particles = createParticles(engine.scene);
27: const audio = window.__mods?.audio;
28: 
29: const projectiles = createProjectiles(engine.scene, {
30:   map,
31:   getPlayer: () => player,
32:   getEnemies: () => enemies.list,
33:   damagePlayer: (d) => applyDamage(d),
34:   onImpact: (x, y, z, type) => {
35:     if (type === 'rocket') {
36:       particles.fire(x, y, z, 14);
37:       particles.smoke(x, y, z, 8);
38:       audio?.play('explosion');
39:       engine.input.my += 4; engine.input.mx += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8;
40:     } else {
41:       particles.fire(x, y, z, 8);
42:       audio?.play('hit');
43:     }
44:   },
45:   sparks: (x, y, z, n, color) => particles.sparks(x, y, z, n, color),
46: });
47: 
48: const enemies = createEnemies(engine.scene, map, {
49:   getPlayer: () => player,
50:   damagePlayer: (d) => applyDamage(d),
51:   spawnFireball: (x, y, z, dx, dz, owner) => projectiles.spawn('fireball', x, y, z, dx, dz, owner),
52:   meleeImpact: (x, z) => { particles.blood(x, 1, z, 6); audio?.play('hit'); },
53:   onKill: (en, x, z) => {
54:     player.kills += 1;
55:     particles.blood(x, 1, z, 10);
56:     audio?.play('kill');
57:     dropFrom(en, x, z);
58:   },
59: });
60: 
61: const weapons = createWeapons(engine, player, engine.scene, {
62:   map,
63:   getEnemies: () => enemies.list,
64:   shoot: () => audio?.play('shot'),
65:   noAmmo: () => audio?.play('noammo'),
66:   spawnProjectile: (o, dir) => projectiles.spawn('rocket', o.x, o.y, o.z, dir.x, dir.z),
67:   impact: (x, y, z) => { particles.sparks(x, y, z, 4); audio?.play('hit'); },
68: });
69: 
70: const minimap = createMinimap(document.getElementById('minimap'), map, () => ({
71:   player, enemies: enemies.list,
72: }));
73: 
74: const hud = createHUD(() => ({
75:   player, weapons,
76:   fps: engine.fps,
77:   locked: engine.input.locked,
78: }));
79: 
80: /* ---- pickups (meshes simples) -------------------------------------------- */
81: const pickupMeshes = [];
82: const pickupGeo = {
83:   health: new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.3, 0.3, 0.3),
84:   armor: new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.34, 0.34, 0.34),
85:   ammo: new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.26, 0.26, 0.26),
86:   weapon: new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.3, 0.2, 0.4),
87: };
88: const pickupMat = {
89:   health: new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x44ff44 }),
90:   armor: new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x44aaff }),
91:   ammo: new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffcc44 }),
92:   weapon: new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff8844 }),
93: };
94: for (const p of map.pickups) {
95:   const cat = p.type === 'health' ? 'health' : p.type === 'armor' ? 'armor' : p.type === 'shotgun' || p.type === 'chaingun' || p.type === 'rocket' ? 'weapon' : 'ammo';
96:   const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(pickupGeo[cat], pickupMat[cat]);
97:   mesh.position.set(p.x, 0.5, p.z);
98:   engine.scene.add(mesh);
99:   pickupMeshes.push({ ...p, cat, mesh });
100: }
101: 
102: function dropFrom(en, x, z) {
103:   const r = Math.random();
104:   if (r < C.PICKUPS.dropAmmoChance) {
105:     const type = en.type === 'baron' || en.type === 'demon' ? 'rocket' : r < C.PICKUPS.dropAmmoChance / 2 ? 'shell' : 'bullet';
106:     weapons.ammo[type] = Math.min(C.WEAPONS[type === 'shell' ? 'shotgun' : type === 'bullet' ? 'chaingun' : 'rocket'].ammoMax, (weapons.ammo[type] || 0) + C.PICKUPS.ammoAmounts[type]);
107:     hud.pushMessage(`+${C.PICKUPS.ammoAmounts[type]} ${type.toUpperCase()}`);
108:   } else if (r < C.PICKUPS.dropAmmoChance + C.PICKUPS.dropHealthChance) {
109:     player.heal(C.PICKUPS.health);
110:     hud.pushMessage(`+${C.PICKUPS.health} HEALTH`);
111:   }
112: }
113: 
114: /* ---- dano / morte / vitória ---------------------------------------------- */
115: function applyDamage(d) {
116:   if (player.dead) return;
117:   if (player.damage(d)) {
118:     hud.flashDamage(d);
119:     audio?.play('hurt');
120:   }
121:   if (player.dead) setState('gameover');
122: }
123: 
124: /* ---- FSM ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
125: let state = 'menu';
126: const screens = {
127:   menu: 'menu-screen',
128:   gameover: 'dead-screen',
129:   win: 'win-screen',
130: };
131: function setState(s) {
132:   state = s;
133:   for (const [k, id] of Object.entries(screens)) {
134:     document.getElementById(id).classList.toggle('show', k === s);
135:   }
136:   if (s === 'playing' && !engine.input.locked) engine.requestLock();
137:   if (s !== 'playing' && document.pointerLockElement) engine.exitLock();
138: }
139: 
140: document.getElementById('btn-start').addEventListener('click', () => {
141:   audio?.init();
142:   setState('playing');
143: });
144: document.getElementById('btn-restart').addEventListener('click', () => location.reload());
145: document.getElementById('btn-win').addEventListener('click', () => location.reload());
146: 
147: /* ---- portas (proximidade) ------------------------------------------------- */
148: function handleDoors(dt) {
149:   for (const d of map.doors) {
150:     const dist = dist2D(player.x, player.z, d.c + 0.5, d.r + 0.5);
151:     const shouldOpen = dist < 1.3;
152:     if (shouldOpen !== d.open) {
153:       d.open = shouldOpen;
154:       if (shouldOpen) audio?.play('door');
155:     }
156:   }
157: }
158: 
159: /* ---- saída / lava / pickups ------------------------------------------------ */
160: function handleWorld(dt) {
161:   if (level.exitPos && dist2D(player.x, player.z, level.exitPos.x, level.exitPos.z) < 1.2 && state === 'playing') {
162:     hud.pushMessage('EXIT REACHED — VICTORY');
163:     setTimeout(() => setState('win'), 600);
164:   }
165:   const r = Math.floor(player.z), c = Math.floor(player.x);
166:   if (map.isLava(r, c) && !player.dead) {
167:     player.health = Math.max(0, player.health - C.LEVEL.lavaDamage * dt);
168:     hud.flashDamage(C.LEVEL.lavaDamage * dt);
169:     if (player.health <= 0 && !player.dead) {
170:       player.dead = true;
171:       setState('gameover');
172:     }
173:   }
174:   for (const p of pickupMeshes) {
175:     if (p.taken) continue;
176:     const d = dist2D(player.x, player.z, p.x, p.z);
177:     if (d > 0.9) continue;
178:     p.taken = true;
179:     p.mesh.visible = false;
180:     audio?.play('pickup');
181:     if (p.type === 'health') {
182:       player.heal(C.PICKUPS.health);
183:       hud.pushMessage(`+${C.PICKUPS.health} HEALTH`);
184:     } else if (p.type === 'armor') {
185:       player.addArmor(C.PICKUPS.armor);
186:       hud.pushMessage(`+${C.PICKUPS.armor} ARMOR`);
187:     } else if (p.type === 'shotgun' || p.type === 'chaingun' || p.type === 'rocket') {
188:       const key = p.type;
189:       weapons.ammo[C.WEAPONS[key].ammoType] = Math.min(C.WEAPONS[key].ammoMax, (weapons.ammo[C.WEAPONS[key].ammoType] || 0) + C.WEAPONS[key].ammoStart);
190:       hud.pushMessage(`${key.toUpperCase()} ACQUIRED`);
191:     } else {
192:       const amount = C.PICKUPS.ammoAmounts[p.type];
193:       weapons.ammo[p.type] = Math.min(C.WEAPONS[p.type === 'bullet' ? 'chaingun' : p.type === 'shell' ? 'shotgun' : 'rocket'].ammoMax, (weapons.ammo[p.type] || 0) + amount);
194:       hud.pushMessage(`+${amount} ${p.type.toUpperCase()}`);
195:     }
196:   }
197:   // bobbing dos pickups
198:   for (const p of pickupMeshes) {
199:     if (!p.taken) p.mesh.rotation.y += dt * 2;
200:   }
201: }
202: 
203: /* ---- loop principal -------------------------------------------------------- */
204: let t = 0;
205: engine.start((dt) => {
206:   t += dt;
207:   if (state === 'playing') {
208:     player.update(dt);
209:     weapons.update(dt);
210:     enemies.update(dt);
211:     projectiles.update(dt);
212:     level.update(dt);
213:     handleDoors(dt);
214:     handleWorld(dt);
215:   } else {
216:     projectiles.update(dt);
217:     level.update(dt);
218:   }
219:   particles.update(dt);
220:   minimap.draw();
221:   hud.update(dt);
222: });
223: 
224: /* ---- API de debug (QA Playwright) ------------------------------------------ */
225: window.__game = {
226:   get state() { return state; },
227:   engine, map, player, weapons, enemies, projectiles, particles, level,
228:   setState,
229:   getState() {
230:     return {
231:       player,
232:       weapons: {
233:         current: weapons.current,
234:         name: weapons.name,
235:         ammo: weapons.ammo,
236:       },
237:       enemies: enemies.list.map((e) => ({ type: e.type, x: e.x, z: e.z, hp: e.hp, dead: e.dead })),
238:       fps: engine.fps.value,
239:       locked: engine.input.locked,
240:     };
241:   },
242:   damagePlayer: (d) => applyDamage(d),
243:   killAll() { enemies.list.forEach((e) => enemies.damageEnemy(e, 9999)); },
244:   giveAmmo(type, n) { weapons.ammo[type] = (weapons.ammo[type] || 0) + n; },
245:   setWeapon(i) { weapons.select(i); },
246:   teleport(x, z) { player.x = x; player.z = z; },
247:   toggleMute() { return audio?.toggleMute(); },
248: };
249: 
250: export default { engine, player };
